tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gtor chog bzhugs so// dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum la gtor ma lag len ltar bshams pa nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ byin rlabs bde kye gang rung bzhin sngon du song nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las e chad pas nam mkhar rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ su las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keng las keng rus brtsegs pa'i ri rab/ de'i steng du thod pa skam po'i gzhal med khang khrag gi chag chag btab cing / glo snying rgyu ma'i dra phyed 'phan tshar can/ zhing lpags kyi bla bre bris pa'i dbus su/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang aṃ las dung dang 'gron bu hūm̐ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gnyis sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ keng rus shin tu 'jigs pa'i tshul can/ spyan bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas thod skam gyi dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bsnams shing gsol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rin po che'i snyan cha 'khyil ba/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ dang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas dur khrod bdag po yab yum la sha za ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che/ /phrin las rnam bzhis don mdzad pa/ /dad ldan dam tshig chen po yi/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃsh+ma sha na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ skad cig gi dbang gi lha 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag cha lhag ma yar lud pa las 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa re res dbu brgyan/ o+oṃ gri ha rā dza gri ha rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ thi ma hā pi shā tsa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñja kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sid+dha m+p+ra yats+tshan+tu swā hā tshar lnga/ oṃ sh+ma sha na pa ti ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dur khrod sha za kun gyi gtso/ /sogs dang / rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob la/ /chos kyi bar chad nyer zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen ma lus 'bad med du/ /'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gtor chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
